ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels forming the central and medial regions, contrasted with 25% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal left lobe contains a large, roughly triangular high-intensity blob interspersed with thin, low-intensity diagonal streaks. Distal right lobe contains a similarly sized but more fragmented high-intensity region characterized by dense, linear low-intensity striations radiating towards the outer edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration with peaks ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in amplitude. The pattern is more jagged and irregular on the outer halves of both lobes compared to the regions flanking the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a moderate concave arc from the median notch extending towards the tips, terminating in sharp, upwardly-tilted distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small (2-5 pixel diameter) circular high-contrast white spots are visible in the lower-central dark region of the left lobe and near the transition zone on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct linear pixel disruptions are visible: a prominent pair of parallel diagonal light-grey lines on the inner right lobe, and multiple smaller, chaotic light-colored scratches across the lower-central dark bridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular missing segments (notches) along the trailing edge suggestive of mechanical trauma. Visible 'rake' marks consisting of multiple parallel linear scars on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between high and low intensity regions on the right distal lobe displays a unique 'leopard-print' mottling effect where small dark pixel clusters are embedded within the larger white field.
